title: Router health in the monitoring view: stuck jobs, waiting ages and failures per monitor
description: Today waiting jobs, ages, timeouts and BatchInProgress are only visible through DynamoDB and CloudWatch. Add them to the monitoring-view response, field-projected so no endpoints, ARNs or account ids leave the function, and show them in papyrus monitors overview. Keep RouterRole policy descriptions untouched: the role is at the 20 managed-policy limit.
